notes.title: Antonblast Release
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42990367/9d3568d4c479ef6da9104f71bc4279613e228cb4.png[/img]

The wait is finally over. After a very successful Kickstarter in 2022 and 100,000 wishlists later, Antonblast has been released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887400/ANTONBLAST/

[b]ANTONBLAST [/b]is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged [b]Dynamite Anton[/b] (or his cranked-out coworker [b]Annie[/b]) and use your [b]Mighty F’n Hammer[/b] to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your [b]Spirits [/b]back from [b]Satan[/b]!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: [b]SET [/b]Brulo's Detonators, [b]FIND [/b]Anton's Spirit, and [b]ESCAPE [/b]before Happy Hour ends!
[list]
[*]     [b]BLAST [/b]through a unique powertrip of a platformer!
[*]     [b]INDULGE [/b]in an urban graffiti-inspired art style!
[*]     [b]DEMOLISH [/b]massive destructible environments!
[*]     [b]BATTLE [/b]brutal, earthshaking bosses!
[*]     [b]EXPERIMENT [/b]with a totally dynamic playstyle; rush through for the best time or explore at your own pace!
[/list]


[h1]FEATURES[/h1]

[list]
[*]     [b]Shock and Awe![/b] Unlike other platforming heroes, Anton's not content to stay in his lane. Jet between the foreground and background layers for 2.5d platforming action!
[*]     [b]Destructible Everything![/b] Use Anton's mighty hammer to break down your environments!
[*]    [b] Hurry Up! It's Happy Hour![/b] Once Anton gets to the end of a level, set off the Spirit Detonator and dash back to the start before everything blows!
[*]     12 unique sprawling worlds with tons to explore!
[*]     Dynamic play style - rush to the end or explore at your own pace!
[*]     Silky smooth platforming gameplay with best-in-class controls!
[*]     Breathtaking hand-drawn animation!
[*]     Brutal earthshaking bosses!
[*]     A groovy, retro-flavored dynamic soundtrack!
[*]     Loads of replay value: Hard Mode, Boss Rush, and more!
[/list]
https://youtu.be/IYqE7h1YNUA?si=Y1q6RAqWK7fWW_Fb

Knock Knock…🚪

Hey, Members! 🐒

It’s official!! Our [b]1st DLC "Two-cage Seasoning Pack” is OUT NOW FOR FREE[/b] to everyone who owns [i]Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099[/i]! 🐵

It's time for you to expand your cages and maintain order for those not following the rules. Download the 2 new free interactive cages + the Christmas, Chinese New Year, and Halloween seasonal content, and dig deeper to uncover new stories in this galaxy.

notes.title: First DLC delayed :(
notes.content:
Dear Members, 

We were very excited to share with you today all the hard work that has culminated in our first free DLC, the [b]Two-Cage Seasoning Pack[/b].

Throughout our planning we focused much in some areas and in doing so, there's a chance we missed some others. Unfortunately, one of the slips is that the DLC was not submitted for review on time to be launched today. 

We are confident that it will be available for everyone to enjoy on [b]December 19th[/b]. 

As a small indie studio, we try our best to be as meticulous as possible to share with you outstanding experiences. Unfortunately, on this occasion things didn’t work out as we hoped. We deeply regret this oversight and we are committed to rectifying this situation. 

We appreciate your understanding and continued support. ❤️

Sincerely,

Fictiorama

notes.title: Two DLCs incoming!
notes.content:
Evening, Monkeys!

This is an official message from the Primate Observation Club. 🐵

First of all, we are thankful and blown away by the support you have shown to the Club. We have never been stronger than we are now in 2099.

Secondly, we wanted to share that we do not only watch, we also listen and we have been listening closely. We know that you want more cages, more monkeys, more mysteries to unravel and more monkey business to get done. Truth is that we are more than happy to provide that for you.

That is why we have been working really hard on two DLCs!


[u][b]DLC 1: [i]TWO-CAGE SEASONING PACK[/i] ☃️🐲🎃[/b][/u]

A one-two punch that packs [b]two new interactive cages[/b], each with their own stories, twists and puzzles to solve. And to season this fine dish, we are adding [b]seasonal based content[/b] that will celebrate Christmas, Chinese New Year, and Halloween, through special decorative elements, seasonal music and very exclusive job offers!

Arriving on [b]December 13th[/b], this 1st DLC will be absolutely [b]FREE[/b]! The seasonal content will be activated during its respective seasons. The DLC can be downloaded at any time, but the seasonal-based content will be accessible on specific dates:

- [b]Christmas content[/b] ☃️ will fill your heart with holiday spirit from December 1st to December 31st.

-[b] Chinese New Year content[/b] 🐲 will be available from January 25th to February 24th.

- [b]Halloween content[/b] 🎃 will be scaring your monkeys from October 10th to November 4th.


[img]https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/mwAtm9HRkmkFxviZBWoe-KeTlAPkzaaD3DsJBa3Rjo-jlikwicRIiglNluPTJVmySBWN2qVMFEfJUhigSZeVAEx1LqW2Qua3rka0kjE3wpxcRk3OCeSYim0l4KCCvZIV6ahRjg5cPEyrFe7AJ0xvfEc[/img]


[u][b]DLC 2: [i]FOUR-CAGE GOURMET PACK[/i] 📹🙉[/b][/u]

Yeah, that’s right, [b]4 more interactive cages[/b]! Each with their own storylines, twists and puzzles.This DLC is set to be available in 2024 at a very affordable price, offering a whole new level of excitement for our dedicated Club members.

Remember, you can start enjoying our first DLC as early as December 13th. Best of all, this 1st DLC is free for all owners of [i]Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099[/i].

The future is bright, and it is all thanks to your endless support!



See you on December 13th!


The Primate Observation Club

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 - Shortcuts & Fixes / Cross Platform Steam Cloud
notes.content:
We have just released an update for Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099, bringing it to version 1.0.9.

The key improvements in version 1.0.9 include:

Shortcuts have been added to the game! Please take a look at the shortcut descriptions in the main menu (currently only available in English and Spanish, translations are ongoing) and enjoy! We believe that the "space bar" shortcut for speeding up time might be a game changer (pun intended).

[list]
[*] The "new day" screen now requires a click to be skipped.
[*] An annoying bug that caused certain LEDs to remain on when they shouldn't have has been fixed.
[*] A bug that caused certain "endings" to be triggered repeatedly has been fixed.
[*] Various minor adjustments have been made.
[/list]

Additionally, we have implemented the cross-platform Steam Cloud save system, allowing players who use both Windows and Mac computers to have a single shared game between the two systems. The Steam Cloud save system can be enabled or disabled on a per-game basis; so, if you play the game on both Windows and Mac computers and wish to maintain different save files for each system, please simply disable the Steam Cloud for Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099.

We value your feedback and would appreciate hearing your thoughts on the new version and these improvements!

We are continuously fine-tuning the game in various aspects. After almost a month since its release, numerous improvements and small tweaks have been made. Rest assured that we are closely monitoring your feedback on Discord, Steam, social media, and other platforms.

Once again, we sincerely appreciate your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - Achievement, Texts & Minor Fixes
notes.content:
We have just released an update for Do Not Feed the Monkeys, bringing it to version 1.0.6. This update focuses on addressing some balancing issues, making minor fixes for different languages and text, and resolving other bugs.

[list]
[*] The achievement "The Law of Robotics" has been rebalanced to reduce its high difficulty. 
[*] Text adjustments and corrections of typos have been made in multiple languages. 
[*] Displaced texts have been repositioned. 
[*] Bug fixes have been implemented to prevent texts from appearing in the wrong languages. 
[*] Adjustments have been made to the logic of certain cages. 
[*] Improvements have been made to the layout of some websites.
[/list]
We highly value your feedback and would greatly appreciate hearing your thoughts on the new version and these improvements!

[b]We are still actively working on resolving other issues that have been reported by you. [/b]Your support and feedback are crucial to ensuring that the game is in the best shape possible, so please keep it coming. [b]You can reach out to us through the game's Steam Forums, our Discord server, or Twitter. [/b]Additionally, [b]if you come across any game-breaking bugs, please contact us via email at pr@fictiorama.com.[/b]

Once again, we sincerely appreciate your support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Resolutions, Readability & Minor Fixes
notes.content:
We have just released an update for Do Not Feed the Monkeys, bringing it to version 1.0.3. This update focuses on addressing readability issues that some users encountered in previous versions, particularly in Chinese, Russian, and Korean languages.

The key improvements in version 1.0.3 include:

[list]
[*] The game now supports resolutions higher than 1080p.
[*] The clarity of the text has been enhanced for all languages.
[*] Optimization has been done for the text outlines in the "cages" (dialogues).
[*] The font size has been increased in certain languages.
[/list]

Please note that enlarging some fonts may have caused a few texts to be displaced by a few pixels. We are actively working on repositioning those texts to ensure that every text in the game appears in its correct place.

We value your feedback and would appreciate hearing your thoughts on the new version and these improvements!


Furthermore, we continue to fine-tune the game in various aspects. For example, we are aware that in very specific situations, a few texts may appear in a different language, or in the cage featuring the mechanic (perhaps you have already encountered her!), there might be an occasional speech bubble placed slightly too high.

Rest assured that we are closely monitoring your feedback on Discord, Steam, social media, and other platforms. We are committed to keeping on polishing the game here and there to enhance the overall experience even more.

Once again, we sincerely appreciate your support!
